tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: RaagviTech
cover_en.hook: I am excited to apply for the opening at RaagviTech, bringing over 5 years of specialized backend and e-commerce engineering experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My background in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, and Spring aligns directly with your technical environment.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring for Rockwell Automation, covering catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, while building robust data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs.

bullets.label: Performance & Operations
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency at Shell, executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, and supported complex production troubleshooting in agile teams.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical execution by analyzing integration problems, writing functional specifications, and collaborating closely with international stakeholders.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise can benefit RaagviTech.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java backend expertise to RaagviTech. Having built and scaled enterprise e-commerce platforms for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about the opportunity to bring my strong technical foundation in REST APIs, integrations, and agile delivery to your engineering team.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to deliver high-performance e-commerce solutions for RaagviTech.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java backend experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in opportunities at RaagviTech. I hold a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for RaagviTech – Kranti Chavan (SAP Commerce Cloud Developer)
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in joining RaagviTech. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, and Spring for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical and techno-functional expertise to your projects.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
